newsitem.title: USA: Gold Reserve wins Venezuela clearance.
newsitem.headline: Gold Reserve wins Venezuela clearance.

text.p: Gold Reserve Corp said Thursday the Venezuelan Ministry of Energy and Mines has approved its application to mine the gold, copper and molybdenum in the hard rock under its Brisas concession.

"This is a very important day for Gold Reserve because approximately 85 percent of the deposit delineated to date is contained in the hard rock, and the most important process in granting the hard rock title has been completed," said Rockne Timm, chief executive.
In a separate release, the company said it has found "extensive gold mineralization" in its hole 464 in the southwest zone of the Brisas concession.
Drilling indicates the hole is open to the north, south and west. Gold Reserve said as a result of its find, it is immediately increasing its drilling acitivity in this area.
